comments.snippet:
This report came from 1.84.0 stable (Release 3716). It is the same crash as #209, #220, #224 and #226: `ComboBox.OnFontChanged` fails while the window moves to a monitor with a different scale. Its own diagnostics name the Quick Connect box as the control whose window is gone.
